title: The Missing Miner
description: Erik Stonepick went up to the old shaft east of Aberdeen three days ago and never came back. His tools are still where he left them and his stake is still driven. Mayor Bjorn wants to know what happened.

objectives.description: Travel to the abandoned mine east of Aberdeen
Search the shaft - four fresh scratches on the post
Find Erik Stonepick or his remains
(Optional) Slay the creature that killed Erik

notes: Soulstone-thread touchpoint per docs/design/quest_web.md row 9 (Tell 1 + Tell 3): the claim was worked over by somebody careful, not robbed - tools and stake left, only the scratches added. Never named, never explained, no NPC reacts. Rule 4 respected: gates nothing, no new flag/objective/reward.
